g.text: A repeatable, bounded episode used inside one step (ADR-0052 d2).
It may not produce the Mission's deliverables, span steps or be a rule.
The check is curation by review, not a schema refusal (d3).
Inline anti_patterns are removed (d4, d16); use rejects.
a file-less anti_pattern node is refused
rejects sits beside references, same shape on every guidance kind (ADR-0052 d9).
Toolguide and agent profiles carry none; mission types and their steps do
Directive, tactic, paradigm and styleguide mint Relation.rejects, never suggests;
a procedure's entry is kept verbatim until #189 rules (d9).
Glossary avoid is not an anti-pattern (d12).
Yellow «pending» / [pending …]: decided in the cited ADR,
but the cited open question is not ruled.
